test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

They will start their journey after the breakfast.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. 'after the breakfast' has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"after the breakfast"** is incorrect because "breakfast" is an **uncountable noun** and should not have the definite article **"the"** before it.
 
• The correct phrase should be "after breakfast" without the article "the".
 
• Using "the" implies a specific breakfast, which is not the case here.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *They will start their journey after breakfast*.
